# Aurevyn AI Automation

> Aurevyn is an AI automation agency that helps
dental clinics, HVAC companies, and real estate
agencies automate their lead replies, appointment
booking, and follow-ups using AI — 24/7, no extra
staff needed.

## Services
- AI Email Reply Agent — replies to every inquiry in 60 seconds
- AI Appointment Booking — books appointments automatically
- AI Lead Generation — finds and contacts leads automatically
- AI Follow-Up System — follows up with every lead automatically

## Pricing
- Discovery call is free
- Projects start from ₹15,000 one time
- No monthly fees
